notes.title: Epstein 2 Update 0.1
notes.content:
Hello dear players!

In the past few weeks, we have added new content and worked intensively to fix existing issues for our game Epstein, based on your valuable feedback. Today, we would like to share the significant updates we have made and the adjustments inspired by our beloved community.

Highlighted Updates:

Bug Fixes: Problems in the game, including item loss issues, have been resolved. A smoother gameplay experience now awaits you.
Important Fixes:

Physical Interactions: Improvements have been made to the physical interactions in the game, providing a more realistic experience.

Interactive Items: Work has been done to enhance the physical reactions of interactive items, increasing the realism of the game.

Electrical Panel: We are aware of the issues related to the Electrical Panel, and we've revised the section involving it, changing the gameplay mechanics.

Usable Items: The usability of items in the game has been improved, and their interaction has been made more accessible.

Exciting Innovations:

Tunnel: We have revised many areas of the Tunnel map. New gameplay mechanics have been added, enhancing playability.

AutoSave System: For players who suffered from losing all their items after dying and having to start over, we have added the AutoSave system to key areas of the game.

Final Section: We noticed the lack of excitement in the final section, so we made it more challenging.

With these updates, we hope your gaming experience becomes richer and more thrilling. Your feedback is very valuable to us, so don't hesitate to share your thoughts. We wish you all enjoyable gaming!
